posts.headline: One Nut Barner has now dodged the flamethrower for twenty straight editions, and a 20-8 career mark with a 1.5 average finish and STILL zero rings is the most Cowboys-without-the-rings résumé in league history.
posts.detail: Put it in Ra has finished 1st or 2nd in both seasons and has nothing to show for it but silence — that's not confidence, Adam, that's a Berkeley grad choking on his own hype.

posts.headline: Big Head's title defense hasn't even started and the fluke jury is already back in session — a 13-15 career record under a championship banner is still the weirdest paradox in this league.
posts.detail: Sasinci's World won it all once but owns a losing overall record at 0.464, so until Alxgalvn stops threatening to quit and starts drafting, the ring stays an asterisk.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh enters the season as the literal untalented tenth, and a 4-10 record with a dead-last 12th place finish means the bar is somewhere in the Earth's mantle.
posts.detail: No titles, no seasons above replacement level, and a 0.286 win pct — Chauncey needs an actual turnaround story, not just a new roster.

posts.headline: Thicks is walking into 2026 with the crown, but a 14-14 career record and a 5.5 average finish says #FreeMaxx Champions backed into that ring more than they dominated for it.
posts.detail: One title in two seasons with a middling overall mark means the target on his back is bigger than his résumé — prove it wasn't a fluke, formerly-known-as-Sticks.

posts.headline: SwooshAnoosh opens 2026 exactly where he left off — buried, at 5-9 with an 11th-place finish, and nobody in this league is picking him to escape the basement.
posts.detail: A 0.357 win pct and worst-finish-equals-only-finish track record means the Prince of Persia needs more than a fresh 0-0 record to change the narrative.
